description.value:
From Khnum · Price: only faces; voice and body stay yours.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 1 action: change your face to look like a person you've seen. +4 status to Deception to Impersonate them. In combat, flash a face a creature within 30 ft trusts or fears (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates; mental, visual): it hesitates, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 round and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} on a critical failure). Once per turn your stand can Strike from behind a friendly face (1 action): the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} against that Strike.
  • 5: Also change a willing ally's face; your trusted face can fool up to 2 creatures at once. A creature your stand's masked Strike hits is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1}. Surge: lasts 1 day; or, in combat, the false face holds for every creature in a @Template[burst|distance:20]{20-ft burst} within 30 ft that sees it: a creature that fails is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} for 1 minute (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} too on a critical failure).
  • 9: The surge's false-face burst is 30 ft.
  • 13: Change voice too; the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{off-guard} from your trusted face lasts 1 minute, and a creature that critically fails against it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{stupefied 1} for 1 round.
  • 17: Reaction: change your face as a creature looks at you, ending a gaze or visual-recognition effect.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.yHlyQmatYtQxl45d]{Effect: Disguise}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
